Do I need to pay to use Islam 24?
No, absolutely not. Islam 24 is 100% free and ad-free forever. Tipping or subscribing is entirely voluntary to help cover development and server costs.
Your support directly funds server infrastructure, domain hosting, licensing for Quran audio recitations, and ongoing app development.
What is the difference between a tip and a subscription?
A One-Time Tip is a single gift of any amount. A Monthly Support subscription recurs automatically each month until you cancel.
Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time directly through Google Play Store subscriptions with zero hassle.
Refunds are handled according to Google Play Store refund policies. You can request a refund through your Google account purchase history.
